name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for ceiling drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for ceiling drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for ceiling drywall repair, prioritize experience specific to drywall and ceiling work. Look for proof of insurance and relevant licenses to ensure you're protected. Ask for references or view a portfolio of past work to assess the quality of their finishes, especially texture matching. Transparent communication, clear estimates, and a professional approach to timelines and site cleanliness are also key indicators of a reliable contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, insurance, licenses, references, clear communication, and detailed estimates.
